item.title: 3 men set for lethal injection on same day in Tennessee, Alabama and Oklahoma
item.description: Three men in Tennessee, Alabama and Oklahoma are scheduled for lethal injection Thursday in a rare convergence of executions on the same day in the U.S.

item.description: Utah-based Our Rescue was founded by activist Tim Ballard. It was previously known as Operation Underground Railroad and it says it helps law enforcement perform sting operations and rescues human trafficking survivors.

item.title: Has the U.S. lost its dominance to China?
item.description: Beijing may be benefiting from the war in Iran and Trump's tariffs and has an edge in the competition for tech supremacy. The New Yorker's Evan Osnos discusses his story "The Future, Made in China."

item.title: Inflation eases in July as gasoline and grocery prices fall
item.description: Consumer prices in July were up 3.4% from a year ago — a smaller annual increase than in May or June. The news makes it less likely the Fed will feel the need to raise interest rates in September.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Greetings from a surreal expanse of sand dunes dotted with freshwater lagoons in Brazil
item.description: The pristine white sand dunes of the Lençóis Maranhenses National Park are bordered by thick jungle on one side and the Atlantic Ocean on the other. Thousands of lagoons fill up after the rainy season.
